store.description: The classic block-building sandbox, rebuilt from scratch for Windows 12. Explore an infinite-feeling voxel world, mine blocks, build structures and save your creations — all rendered in real-time 3D with a handcrafted WebGL engine.
features: Real-time 3D voxel world with chunk-based rendering
Procedurally generated terrain: hills, lakes, beaches and trees
10 placeable block types with a classic hotbar
Mine and build with raycast block picking and wireframe highlight
Full physics: gravity, jumping, swimming and collision
Worlds persist across sessions (seed + edits saved to disk)
Procedural textures and sound effects — no external assets
Touch controls: virtual joystick, drag-to-look, tap to mine
